sanskrit: guruśuśrūṣayā kuntyā yamayor vinayena ca tutoṣa lokaḥ sakalas teṣāṃ śauryaguṇena ca
english: By Kuntī's devoted service to her elders and by the humility of the twin sons, the whole world was pleased — as also by their quality of valour.

sanskrit: samavāye tato rājñāṃ kanyāṃ bhartṛsvayaṃvarām prāptavān arjunaḥ kṛṣṇāṃ kṛtvā karma suduṣkaram
english: Then, at the assembly of kings gathered for the princess's self-choice of a husband, Arjuna won Kṛṣṇā (Draupadī) by performing a most difficult feat.

sanskrit: tataḥ prabhṛti loke 'smin pūjyaḥ sarvadhanuṣmatām āditya iva duṣprekṣyaḥ samareṣv api cābhavat
english: From that time onward, he was honoured in this world as the foremost of all bowmen, blazing like the sun and hard to behold even in battle.

sanskrit: sa sarvān pārthivāñ jitvā sarvāṃś ca mahato gaṇān ājahārārjuno rājñe rājasūyaṃ mahākratum
english: Arjuna, having conquered all kings and all great confederacies, brought back to the king (Yudhiṣṭhira) the tribute needed for the great Rājasūya sacrifice.

sanskrit: annavān dakṣiṇāvāṃś ca sarvaiḥ samudito guṇaiḥ yudhiṣṭhireṇa saṃprāpto rājasūyo mahākratuḥ
english: The great Rājasūya sacrifice performed by Yudhiṣṭhira was endowed with abundant food and rich sacrificial fees, adorned with every auspicious quality.

sanskrit: sunayād vāsudevasya bhīmārjunabalena ca ghātayitvā jarāsaṃdhaṃ caidyaṃ ca balagarvitam
english: Through the wise counsel of Vāsudeva and through the might of Bhīma and Arjuna, Jarāsaṃdha and the Cedi king (Śiśupāla) — who was proud of his strength — were slain.

sanskrit: duryodhanam upāgacchann arhaṇāni tatas tataḥ maṇikāñcanaratnāni gohastyaśvadhanāni ca
english: Then tribute and homage — jewels, gold, precious gems, cattle, elephants, horses, and wealth — came from every quarter to Duryodhana.

sanskrit: samṛddhāṃ tāṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍavānāṃ tadā śriyam īrṣyāsamutthaḥ sumahāṃs tasya manyur ajāyata
english: Seeing that great and thriving prosperity of the Pāṇḍavas, an immense rage born of envy arose in him (Duryodhana).

sanskrit: vimānapratimāṃ cāpi mayena sukṛtāṃ sabhām pāṇḍavānām upahṛtāṃ sa dṛṣṭvā paryatapyata
english: Seeing the assembly hall of the Pāṇḍavas — built with consummate skill by Maya and resembling a celestial palace — presented to them, he was consumed with anguish.

sanskrit: yatrāvahasitaś cāsīt praskandann iva saṃbhramāt pratyakṣaṃ vāsudevasya bhīmenānabhijātavat
english: There he had been laughed at by Bhīma — before the very eyes of Vāsudeva — as he stumbled in his confusion, like one of base birth.

sanskrit: sa bhogān vividhān bhuñjan ratnāni vividhāni ca kathito dhṛtarāṣṭrasya vivarṇo hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
english: Though enjoying varied pleasures and divers jewels, when reported to Dhṛtarāṣṭra he had grown pale, wan, and emaciated.

sanskrit: anvajānāt tato dyūtaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ sutapriyaḥ tac chrutvā vāsudevasya kopaḥ samabhavan mahān
english: Then Dhṛtarāṣṭra, doting on his son, consented to the dice game. Hearing of this, Vāsudeva's anger was greatly aroused.

sanskrit: nātiprītamanāś cāsīd vivādāṃś cānvamodata dyūtādīn anayān ghorān pravṛddhāṃś cāpy upaikṣata
english: He (Dhṛtarāṣṭra) was not greatly pleased in his heart, yet he approved the quarrels, and looked on while horrible unrighteous acts born of gambling and the like grew and spread.

sanskrit: nirasya viduraṃ droṇaṃ bhīṣmaṃ śāradvataṃ kṛpam vigrahe tumule tasminn ahan kṣatraṃ parasparam
english: Setting aside Vidura, Droṇa, Bhīṣma, Kṛpa the son of Śaradvat — in that tumultuous conflict, the kṣatriya warriors destroyed each other.

sanskrit: jayatsu pāṇḍuputreṣu śrutvā sumahad apriyam duryodhanamataṃ jñātvā karṇasya śakunes tathā dhṛtarāṣṭraś ciraṃ dhyātvā saṃjayaṃ vākyam abravīt
english: When the sons of Pāṇḍu were victorious, having heard the most grievous ill tidings and knowing the counsel of Duryodhana, Karṇa, and Śakuni, Dhṛtarāṣṭra reflected for a long time and then addressed these words to Saṃjaya.

sanskrit: śṛṇu saṃjaya me sarvaṃ na me 'sūyitum arhasi śrutavān asi medhāvī buddhimān prājñasaṃmataḥ
english: "Hear everything from me, Saṃjaya — do not find fault with me. You are learned, intelligent, wise, and esteemed by the discerning."

sanskrit: na vigrahe mama matir na ca prīye kurukṣaye na me viśeṣaḥ putreṣu sveṣu pāṇḍusuteṣu ca
english: "My mind does not desire this conflict, nor do I rejoice in the destruction of the Kurus. I make no distinction between my own sons and the sons of Pāṇḍu."

sanskrit: vṛddhaṃ mām abhyasūyanti putrā manyuparāyaṇāḥ ahaṃ tv acakṣuḥ kārpaṇyāt putraprītyā sahāmi tat muhyantaṃ cānumuhyāmi duryodhanam acetanam
english: "My sons, given over to rage, bear malice toward me in my old age. But I, being blind, endure it out of wretchedness and love for my sons — and I follow foolish, senseless Duryodhana in his delusion."

sanskrit: rājasūye śriyaṃ dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍavasya mahaujasaḥ tac cāvahasanaṃ prāpya sabhārohaṇadarśane
english: "Having witnessed the splendour of the mighty Pāṇḍava at the Rājasūya, and then having endured that mockery at the sight of the assembly hall —"

sanskrit: amarṣitaḥ svayaṃ jetum aśaktaḥ pāṇḍavān raṇe nirutsāhaś ca saṃprāptuṃ śriyam akṣatriyo yathā gāndhārarājasahitaś chadmadyūtam amantrayat
english: "— burning with indignation yet unable to conquer the Pāṇḍavas in battle, and incapable of winning their prosperity by valiant means like a true kṣatriya, together with the king of Gāndhāra he devised treacherous gambling."

sanskrit: tatra yad yad yathā jñātaṃ mayā saṃjaya tac chṛṇu śrutvā hi mama vākyāni buddhyā yuktāni tattvataḥ tato jñāsyasi māṃ saute prajñācakṣuṣam ity uta
english: "In that matter, hear from me, Saṃjaya, everything as I came to know it. Having heard my words, which are informed by wisdom and truth, you will then recognise me, O Sūta's son, as one who sees with the eye of understanding."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ dhanur āyamya citraṃ; viddhaṃ lakṣyaṃ pātitaṃ vai pṛthivyām kṛṣṇāṃ hṛtāṃ paśyatāṃ sarvarājñāṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that the wondrous target had been pierced and brought down to earth with a drawn bow, and that Kṛṣṇā had been won before the eyes of all the assembled kings — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ dvārakāyāṃ subhadrāṃ; prasahyoḍhāṃ mādhavīm arjunena indraprasthaṃ vṛṣṇivīrau ca yātau; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Subhadrā, the Mādhavī lady, had been carried off by force by Arjuna at Dvārakā, and that the two heroes of the Vṛṣṇi clan had gone to Indraprastha — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ devarājaṃ pravṛṣṭaṃ; śarair divyair vāritaṃ cārjunena agniṃ tathā tarpitaṃ khāṇḍave ca; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Indra the king of gods had been repelled by Arjuna with divine arrows, and that Agni had been satiated in the Khāṇḍava forest — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ hṛtarājyaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraṃ; parājitaṃ saubalenākṣavatyām anvāgataṃ bhrātṛbhir aprameyais; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Yudhiṣṭhira, his kingdom seized, had been defeated by Śakuni in the dice game, yet was followed into exile by his immeasurable brothers — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ draupadīm aśrukaṇṭhīṃ; sabhāṃ nītāṃ duḥkhitām ekavastrām rajasvalāṃ nāthavatīm anāthavat; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Draupadī, weeping in her throat, was dragged in grief to the assembly hall wearing but a single cloth, in her menses, though she had protectors, treated as if she had none — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ vividhās tāta ceṣṭā; dharmātmanāṃ prasthitānāṃ vanāya jyeṣṭhaprītyā kliśyatāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard of the manifold endeavours of those righteous ones — the Pāṇḍavas — who set out for the forest and suffered hardship out of loyalty to their eldest brother — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ snātakānāṃ sahasrair; anvāgataṃ dharmarājaṃ vanastham bhikṣābhujāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that the Dharma-king, dwelling in the forest, was followed by thousands of high-souled brāhmaṇas who were snātakas living on alms — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣam arjuno devadevaṃ; kirātarūpaṃ tryambakaṃ toṣya yuddhe avāpa tat pāśupataṃ mahāstraṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Arjuna had propitiated the god of gods — three-eyed Tryambaka (Śiva) in the form of a Kirāta — in battle and obtained that great weapon the Pāśupata — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ tridivasthaṃ dhanaṃjayaṃ; śakrāt sākṣād divyam astraṃ yathāvat adhīyānaṃ śaṃsitaṃ satyasaṃdhaṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Dhanaṃjaya, dwelling in the heavens, properly received divine weapons from Indra in person — he of firm truth being thus extolled — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ vaiśravaṇena sārdhaṃ; samāgataṃ bhīmam anyāṃś ca pārthān tasmin deśe mānuṣāṇām agamye; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Bhīma and the other sons of Pṛthā had met with Vaiśravaṇa (Kubera) in that region inaccessible to mortals — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ ghoṣayātrāgatānāṃ; bandhaṃ gandharvair mokṣaṇaṃ cārjunena sveṣāṃ sutānāṃ karṇabuddhau ratānāṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that those who came on the cattle-tour had been captured by the Gandharvas, and were released by Arjuna — the very sons of mine who had set their minds on following Karṇa's counsel — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ yakṣarūpeṇa dharmaṃ; samāgataṃ dharmarājena sūta praśnān uktān vibruvantaṃ ca samyak; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Dharma in the form of a Yakṣa had met the Dharma-king, O Sūta, posing questions and answering them all correctly — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ māmakānāṃ variṣṭhān; dhanaṃjayenaikarathena bhagnān virāṭarāṣṭre vasatā mahātmanā; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that the foremost of my warriors had been routed single-handedly by the great-souled Dhanaṃjaya while he dwelt in the kingdom of Virāṭa — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ satkṛtāṃ matsyarājñā; sutāṃ dattām uttarām arjunāya tāṃ cārjunaḥ pratyagṛhṇāt sutārthe; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that the king of Matsya honoured and gave his daughter Uttarā to Arjuna, and that Arjuna accepted her for his son (Abhimanyu) — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ nirjitasyādhanasya; pravrājitasya svajanāt pracyutasya akṣauhiṇīḥ sapta yudhiṣṭhirasya; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that seven akṣauhiṇī armies had rallied to Yudhiṣṭhira — he who had been vanquished, stripped of wealth, banished, and separated from his kinsmen — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ naranārāyaṇau tau; kṛṣṇārjunau vadato nāradasya ahaṃ draṣṭā brahmaloke sadeti; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Nārada declared of those two — Kṛṣṇa and Arjuna, who are Nara and Nārāyaṇa — 'I have seen them eternally in the world of Brahma' — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ mādhavaṃ vāsudevaṃ; sarvātmanā pāṇḍavārthe niviṣṭam yasyemāṃ gāṃ vikramam ekam āhus; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Mādhava Vāsudeva had committed himself wholly to the Pāṇḍavas' cause — he of whom they say a single stride of his encompasses this earth — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ karṇaduryodhanābhyāṃ; buddhiṃ kṛtāṃ nigrahe keśavasya taṃ cātmānaṃ bahudhā darśayānaṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Karṇa and Duryodhana had resolved to seize Keśava, and that he thereupon revealed his own self in manifold forms — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ vāsudeve prayāte; rathasyaikām agratas tiṣṭhamānām ārtāṃ pṛthāṃ sāntvitāṃ keśavena; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that, as Vāsudeva was departing, he stood in front of his chariot, and Pṛthā (Kuntī) in her anguish was comforted by Keśava — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ mantriṇaṃ vāsudevaṃ; tathā bhīṣmaṃ śāṃtanavaṃ ca teṣām bhāradvājaṃ cāśiṣo 'nubruvāṇaṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Vāsudeva was their counsellor, that Bhīṣma son of Śantanu was likewise on their side, and that Droṇa son of Bharadvāja was uttering blessings for them — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ karṇa uvāca bhīṣmaṃ; nāhaṃ yotsye yudhyamāne tvayīti hitvā senām apacakrāma caiva; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Karṇa said to Bhīṣma, 'I shall not fight while you are fighting,' and thereupon abandoned the army and withdrew — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ vāsudevārjunau tau; tathā dhanur gāṇḍivam aprameyam trīṇy ugravīryāṇi samāgatāni; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that those two — Vāsudeva and Arjuna — and likewise the bow Gāṇḍīva of immeasurable power — these three of fierce valour — had come together — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ kaśmalenābhipanne; rathopasthe sīdamāne 'rjune vai kṛṣṇaṃ lokān darśayānaṃ śarīre; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Arjuna, overwhelmed by despondency, was sinking down on the chariot floor, and that Kṛṣṇa revealed the worlds within his own body — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ bhīṣmam amitrakarśanaṃ; nighnantam ājāv ayutaṃ rathānām naiṣāṃ kaś cid vadhyate dṛśyarūpas; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Bhīṣma, crusher of enemies, was slaying ten thousand charioteers in the battle, and that none of these (Pāṇḍavas) of visible form was being killed — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ bhīṣmam atyantaśūraṃ; hataṃ pārthenāhaveṣv apradhṛṣyam śikhaṇḍinaṃ purataḥ sthāpayitvā; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Bhīṣma — supremely heroic and unassailable in battle — had been felled by Pārtha (Arjuna) after placing Śikhaṇḍin in front — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ śaratalpe śayānaṃ; vṛddhaṃ vīraṃ sāditaṃ citrapuṅkhaiḥ bhīṣmaṃ kṛtvā somakān alpaśeṣāṃs; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that the aged hero Bhīṣma, having reduced the Somakas to a handful, lay on his bed of arrows, brought down by shafts with beautiful feathering — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ śāṃtanave śayāne; pānīyārthe coditenārjunena bhūmiṃ bhittvā tarpitaṃ tatra bhīṣmaṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that as Bhīṣma, son of Śantanu, lay (on his arrow-bed) and asked for water, Arjuna, urged to provide it, pierced the earth and there satisfied Bhīṣma's thirst — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ śukrasūryau ca yuktau; kaunteyānām anulomau jayāya nityaṃ cāsmāñ śvāpadā vyābhaṣantas; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that both Venus (Śukra) and the Sun were favourably aligned for the sons of Kuntī toward victory, and that beasts of prey always cried out against us — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadā droṇo vividhān astramārgān; vidarśayan samare citrayodhī na pāṇḍavāñ śreṣṭhatamān nihanti; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When Droṇa, a wondrous warrior, displaying manifold paths of his weapons in battle, still could not slay the foremost of the Pāṇḍavas — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ cāsmadīyān mahārathān; vyavasthitān arjunasyāntakāya saṃśaptakān nihatān arjunena; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that the great warriors on our side, the Saṃśaptakas who had pledged themselves to bring about Arjuna's death, were slain by Arjuna — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ vyūham abhedyam anyair; bhāradvājenāttaśastreṇa guptam bhittvā saubhadraṃ vīram ekaṃ praviṣṭaṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that the heroic son of Subhadrā (Abhimanyu) alone had broken and entered the battle-array, impenetrable to others, guarded by Droṇa son of Bharadvāja who had taken up his weapons — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadābhimanyuṃ parivārya bālaṃ; sarve hatvā hṛṣṭarūpā babhūvuḥ mahārathāḥ pārtham aśaknuvantas; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When all the great warriors together surrounded and slew that young Abhimanyu — rejoicing in their faces as they did so — because they were unable to face Pārtha (Arjuna) — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣam abhimanyuṃ nihatya; harṣān mūḍhān krośato dhārtarāṣṭrān krodhaṃ muktaṃ saindhave cārjunena; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that, after Abhimanyu was slain, the sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra who shouted in foolish exultation had the wrath of Arjuna unleashed upon the Sindhu king (Jayadratha) — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ saindhavārthe pratijñāṃ; pratijñātāṃ tadvadhāyārjunena satyāṃ nistīrṇāṃ śatrumadhye ca tena; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that the vow taken by Arjuna to slay the Sindhu king had been fulfilled — true to his word, accomplished in the midst of his enemies — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ śrāntahaye dhanaṃjaye; muktvā hayān pāyayitvopavṛttān punar yuktvā vāsudevaṃ prayātaṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that as Dhanaṃjaya's horses were exhausted, Vāsudeva unharnessed them, watered them, let them recover, then reharnessed them and proceeded — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ vāhaneṣv āśvasatsu; rathopasthe tiṣṭhatā gāṇḍivena sarvān yodhān vāritān arjunena; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that while the horses were recovering, Arjuna, standing on the chariot platform, held back all the warriors with his Gāṇḍīva bow — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ nāgabalair durutsahaṃ; droṇānīkaṃ yuyudhānaṃ pramathya yātaṃ vārṣṇeyaṃ yatra tau kṛṣṇapārthau; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Yuyudhāna (Sātyaki), having crushed Droṇa's army — hard to overcome as it was with the strength of elephants — went to where those two Kṛṣṇa and Pārtha were, following the Vārṣṇeya — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ karṇam āsādya muktaṃ; vadhād bhīmaṃ kutsayitvā vacobhiḥ dhanuṣkoṭyā tudya karṇena vīraṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Bhīma, having encountered Karṇa and been spared from death, was struck with the tip of Karṇa's bow and taunted with words of reproach by that hero Karṇa — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadā droṇaḥ kṛtavarmā kṛpaś ca; karṇo drauṇir madrarājaś ca śūraḥ amarṣayan saindhavaṃ vadhyamānaṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When Droṇa, Kṛtavarman, Kṛpa, Karṇa, Droṇa's son (Aśvatthāman), and the valiant king of Madra could not bear watching the Sindhu king being slain — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ devarājena dattāṃ; divyāṃ śaktiṃ vyaṃsitāṃ mādhavena ghaṭotkace rākṣase ghorarūpe; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that the divine Śakti spear given by Indra had been deflected by Mādhava — spent instead against Ghaṭotkaca the Rākṣasa of terrifying form — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ karṇaghaṭotkacābhyāṃ; yuddhe muktāṃ sūtaputreṇa śaktim yayā vadhyaḥ samare savyasācī; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that in the battle between Karṇa and Ghaṭotkaca the sūta's son (Karṇa) had released the Śakti — by which Savyasācin (Arjuna) would have been slain in combat — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ droṇam ācāryam ekaṃ; dhṛṣṭadyumnenābhyatikramya dharmam rathopasthe prāyagataṃ viśastaṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that the teacher Droṇa alone, having set aside his weapons on the chariot floor in preparation for death, was slain by Dhṛṣṭadyumna in transgression of dharma — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ drauṇinā dvairathasthaṃ; mādrīputraṃ nakulaṃ lokamadhye samaṃ yuddhe pāṇḍavaṃ śūraṃ yudhyamānaṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that the son of Mādrī, Nakula the heroic Pāṇḍava, engaged in equal single-chariot combat with Droṇa's son, fighting bravely before the eyes of the world — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadā droṇe nihate droṇaputro; nārāyaṇaṃ divyam astraṃ vikurvan naiṣām antaṃ gatavān pāṇḍavānāṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When Droṇa was slain and Droṇa's son unleashed the divine Nārāyaṇa weapon, yet could not bring about the end of the Pāṇḍavas — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ karṇam atyantaśūraṃ; hataṃ pārthenāhaveṣv apradhṛṣyam tasmin bhrātṝṇāṃ vigrahe devaguhye; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Karṇa — supremely heroic, unassailable in battle — was slain by Pārtha in that conflict of brothers, a secret known to the gods — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ droṇaputraṃ kṛpaṃ ca; duḥśāsanaṃ kṛtavarmāṇam ugram yudhiṣṭhiraṃ śūnyam adharṣayantaṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Droṇa's son, Kṛpa, Duḥśāsana, and fierce Kṛtavarman were unable to overpower Yudhiṣṭhira who stood virtually alone — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ nihataṃ madrarājaṃ; raṇe śūraṃ dharmarājena sūta sadā saṃgrāme spardhate yaḥ sa kṛṣṇaṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that the valiant king of Madra — he who always rivalled Kṛṣṇa in battle — was slain in combat by the Dharma-king, O Sūta — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ kalahadyūtamūlaṃ; māyābalaṃ saubalaṃ pāṇḍavena hataṃ saṃgrāme sahadevena pāpaṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that sinful Śakuni — son of Subala, the root of the quarrel and the dice game, relying on his power of illusion — was slain in battle by the Pāṇḍava Sahadeva — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ śrāntam ekaṃ śayānaṃ; hradaṃ gatvā stambhayitvā tad ambhaḥ duryodhanaṃ virathaṃ bhagnadarpaṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Duryodhana — exhausted, chariotless, his pride shattered — had gone to a lake and stilled its waters to hide within it, lying there alone — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ pāṇḍavāṃs tiṣṭhamānān; gaṅgāhrade vāsudevena sārdham amarṣaṇaṃ dharṣayataḥ sutaṃ me; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that the Pāṇḍavas, standing together with Vāsudeva on the bank of the Gaṅgā lake, were provoking my wrathful son — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ vividhāṃs tāta mārgān; gadāyuddhe maṇḍalaṃ saṃcarantam mithyā hataṃ vāsudevasya buddhyā; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that, as he circled through the various paths of mace-fighting, he was wrongfully struck down through the stratagem of Vāsudeva — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ droṇaputrādibhis tair; hatān pāñcālān draupadeyāṃś ca suptān kṛtaṃ bībhatsam ayaśasyaṃ ca karma; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Droṇa's son and the others slew the Pāñcālas and the sons of Draupadī while they slept — a gruesome, inglorious act — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ bhīmasenānuyātena; aśvatthāmnā paramāstraṃ prayuktam kruddhenaiṣīkam avadhīd yena garbhaṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that Aśvatthāman, pursued by Bhīmasena, in his fury unleashed the supreme weapon — the Aiṣīka — by which he struck the embryo in the womb — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ brahmaśiro 'rjunena; muktaṃ svastīty astram astreṇa śāntam aśvatthāmnā maṇiratnaṃ ca dattaṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
english: "When I heard that the Brahmaśiras weapon fired by Arjuna was peacefully neutralised weapon-against-weapon by Aśvatthāman, and that Aśvatthāman gave up the jewel-gem from his head — then, Saṃjaya, I had no hope of victory."

sanskrit: yadāśrauṣaṃ droṇaputreṇa garbhe; vairāṭyā vai pātyamāne mahāstre dvaipāyanaḥ keśavo droṇaputraṃ; paraspareṇābhiśāpaiḥ śaśāpa
english: "When I heard that as Droṇa's son unleashed the great weapon against Uttarā's womb, Dvaipāyana and Keśava cursed Droṇa's son with mutual imprecations — then (I had no hope of victory)."

sanskrit: śocyā gāndhārī putrapautrair vihīnā; tathā vadhvaḥ pitṛbhir bhrātṛbhiś ca kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ duṣkaraṃ pāṇḍaveyaiḥ; prāptaṃ rājyam asapatnaṃ punas taiḥ
english: "Pitiable is Gāndhārī, bereft of sons and grandsons; so too are the daughters-in-law (widows) bereft of fathers and brothers. The Pāṇḍavas have accomplished a most difficult task and have regained a kingdom free of rivals."

sanskrit: kaṣṭaṃ yuddhe daśa śeṣāḥ śrutā me; trayo 'smākaṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca sapta dvyūnā viṃśatir āhatākṣauhiṇīnāṃ; tasmin saṃgrāme vigrahe kṣatriyāṇām
english: "Alas — in the war I have heard that ten survived: three of our side and seven of the Pāṇḍavas'; and eighteen less two akṣauhiṇī armies were destroyed in that great conflict, that slaughter of kṣatriyas."

sanskrit: tamasā tv abhyavastīrṇo moha āviśatīva mām saṃjñāṃ nopalabhe sūta mano vihvalatīva me
english: "I am covered over by darkness; delusion seems to enter me. I cannot recover my senses, O Sūta — my mind seems to reel."

sanskrit: ity uktvā dhṛtarāṣṭro 'tha vilapya bahuduḥkhitaḥ mūrcchitaḥ punar āśvastaḥ saṃjayaṃ vākyam abravīt
english: Having said this, Dhṛtarāṣṭra lamented and fell into a swoon in his great grief; then, having recovered his senses, he addressed these words once more to Saṃjaya.
